svg.aria-label: Revive AI. Autonomous revenue recovery for Razorpay. The AI only recommends. A deterministic policy engine decides, and every execution is gated by a live Razorpay re-check. A deliberate 5-webhook concurrency storm exposed a real race condition; the root cause was found and fixed before shipping. github.com/Aadarsh6/Revenue-Recover-Razorpay-AI
